title: Extraction of alarm substance in zebrafish
author: Rhayra Xavier do Carmo Silva
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.tr3em8n

steps.title: Isolate donor fish
steps.instruction: Separate a donor fish from the home tank and transport it to the experiment area.

steps.title: Prepare crushed ice
steps.instruction: Make crushed ice by crushing mineral‑water ice cubes.

steps.title: Prepare chilled water bath
steps.instruction: Fill a 2 L graduated plastic beaker (Bio Basic Inc., catalog #BK044-2K.SIZE.1) with water from the fish facility, then add ice chips until the temperature reaches 17 °C.

substeps.instruction: Fill the 2 L beaker with facility water.
Add ice chips and monitor temperature until it reads 17 °C.

steps.title: Anesthetize fish in ice bath
steps.instruction: Using a net, transfer the fish into the cold water, then slowly add more ice chips to lower the temperature to 12 °C; the fish is considered anesthetized when it no longer reacts to gentle manipulation.

substeps.instruction: Transfer fish from its container to the chilled water using a net.
Slowly add ice chips until the water temperature reaches 12 °C.
Confirm anesthesia by checking lack of response to gentle manipulation.

steps.title: Transfer fish to Petri dish
steps.instruction: Transfer the anesthetized fish to a glass Petri dish (90 × 15 cm).

steps.title: Decapitate and bleed fish
steps.instruction: Quickly decapitate the animal with a scalpel, discard the head, and remove excess blood using a cotton‑gauze swab (10 × 10 cm, 8‑ply, catalog #G5201).

steps.title: Place body in second dish
steps.instruction: Transfer the remaining body to a second glass Petri dish.

steps.title: Make superficial trunk cuts
steps.instruction: Using a scalpel, make 15 superficial cuts on each side of the trunk.

steps.title: Rinse body with water
steps.instruction: Wash the body with 10 ml of distilled water (ddH₂O).

steps.title: Collect alarm substance solution
steps.instruction: Remove scales and other impurities from the solution, transfer 7 ml of the cleared solution into a sterile 15 ml Falcon tube, and store on ice or in a refrigerator for up to 4 h.

substeps.instruction: Remove scales and any visible impurities from the solution.
Pipette 7 ml of the cleared solution into a sterile 15 ml Falcon tube.
Keep the tube on ice or at 4 °C for no longer than 4 hours.
